name: approve_aish_execution_plan
purpose: Record the human approval of the current immutable plan hash of an AISH Cockpit session, authorizing all its nodes (and their financial caps) for dispatch.
useWhen: The owner explicitly told you to approve this exact planHash for this session
Session status is awaiting-approval and readiness fails only on current-plan-not-approved
avoidWhen: The owner has not explicitly approved: ask the owner (they can approve the hash in the /aish Cockpit UI); never self-approve
The plan is still changing: put_aish_execution_plan first
A standalone job: approve_aish_job_execution
A release/deploy step: approve_aish_release

inputs.notes: 8-240 chars; reuse only to retry the same approval

preconditions: Explicit owner instruction to approve this hash
Caller can manage the session's workspace and holds the active coordinator lease
planHash == session.currentPlanHash
Session status awaiting-approval (or already approved with the same hash)
All readiness facts except approval are ready, including an online runner with free capacity
returns: {session:{status:'approved', approvedPlanHash, ...}, readiness:{ready, facts, reasons}, reused}

errors.fix: You sent old lease values or another coordinator took over. Re-acquire; if acquire says 'already has an active coordinator', stop and tell the user.

avoidWhen: A human typed the transcript: record_aish_intake_transcript with source {kind:'manual'}
Job is not leased/approved/funded: transcription is refused
A second audio in the same attempt: needs another funded job

errors.fix: A prior claim has an unknown outcome. Do NOT call Whisper again; report reconciliation-required.

errors.when: Intake requires an active issue in its canonical project workspace. / Transcription project workspace changed.
errors.fix: Activity deleted or moved; stop and report.

name: create_aish_job

avoidWhen: Multi-step or multi-project work with dependencies: Cockpit session (create_aish_execution_session + put_aish_execution_plan)

array of strings, max 20 (e.g. local-command, git, node, npm, codex-cli)
<= 500 chars. Same key + same payload returns the same job; same key + different payload fails

setup | scope | planning | build | validation | local-deploy | staging | production; only with agentBinding
